basic_info.description: Embrace the San Francisco lifestyle in this elegantly updated 4 bedroom 2 bath Silver Terrace home. Step into a bright and inviting atmosphere enhanced by freshly painted interiors and newly refinished floors on the main level complemented by new luxury vinyl flooring in the lower level and kitchen. Retreat to the primary bedroom and awaken to captivating views. This home provides a wonderful opportunity to experience the vibrant San Francisco lifestyle from a beautifully updated property where every room is filled with light. The top floor offers 3 bedrooms, a living room, full bath and eat in kitchen. The lower floor has a bedroom, family room and bath. Enjoy the best of San Francisco living with nearby parks, shops, and restaurants along San Bruno Ave, plus easy access to transportation and freeways, all within the peaceful charm of this established neighborhood.
